meta.comment: PHASE 3 milestone catalog (ROADMAP 'Milestones (threshold rewards: first X qi, first breakthrough, ...)'). Each milestone grants a ONE-SHOT reward when a lifetime statistics counter crosses its threshold. LORE DISCIPLINE: milestone rewards are one-shot gifts — the canonical 'breakthrough gifts' in DESIGN.md 'Spirit Stone Acquisition' (personal cultivation produces qi, not stones; gifts are one-time, NEVER a per-second producer, NEVER repeatable — a reached milestone fires exactly once, ever, and the reached map persists in state). stat MUST be one of the four lifetime counter keys (playtimeMs, meditationsCompleted, breakthroughsTotal, qiGenerated — STATISTICS_KEYS in js/systems/statistics.js); threshold is a finite positive number; reward maps resourceId → amount, every id resolving in config.resources.items (data/game-config.json).
